name: Fire Bolt
description: Hurl a mote of fire at a creature or object within range.
descriptionRu: Метните искру пламени в существо или предмет в пределах дистанции.

name: Ray of Frost
description: A frigid beam of blue-white light streaks toward a creature.
descriptionRu: Морозный бело-голубой луч устремляется к существу.

name: Mage Hand
description: A spectral, floating hand appears and can manipulate objects at a distance.
descriptionRu: Призрачная парящая рука появляется и может манипулировать предметами на расстоянии.

name: Minor Illusion
description: Create a sound or an image of an object within range.
descriptionRu: Создайте звук или образ предмета в пределах дистанции.

name: Acid Splash
description: Hurl a bubble of acid at one or two creatures within range.
descriptionRu: Метните пузырь кислоты в одну или две цели в пределах дистанции.

name: Blade Ward
description: Ward yourself against physical harm, gaining resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage until your next turn.
descriptionRu: Защититесь от физического урона, получая сопротивление дробящему, колющему и рубящему урону до начала следующего хода.

name: Chill Touch
description: A ghostly, skeletal hand reaches out to assail a creature with the chill of the grave.
descriptionRu: Призрачная костлявая рука тянется к существу, поражая его могильным холодом.

name: Dancing Lights
description: Create up to four torch-sized lights that hover and move as you direct.
descriptionRu: Создайте до четырёх огоньков размером с факел, которые парят и двигаются по вашей воле.

name: Druidcraft
description: Call up a minor nature effect, such as predicting the weather or making a flower bloom.
descriptionRu: Вызовите небольшой природный эффект: предскажите погоду или заставьте цветок распуститься.

name: Friends
description: Gain advantage on Charisma checks toward one creature, who becomes hostile once the spell ends.
descriptionRu: Получите преимущество на проверки Харизмы против одного существа, которое станет враждебным, когда заклинание закончится.

name: Guidance
description: Touch a willing creature and give it an extra d4 to add to one ability check of its choice.
descriptionRu: Коснитесь согласного существа и дайте ему d4, который можно добавить к одной проверке характеристики.

name: Light
description: Make an object shed bright light in a 20-foot radius.
descriptionRu: Заставьте предмет излучать яркий свет в радиусе 20 футов.

name: Mending
description: Mend a single break or tear in an object you touch.
descriptionRu: Почините один разлом или разрыв на предмете, которого касаетесь.

name: Message
description: Whisper a message to a creature of your choice within range, heard only by that creature.
descriptionRu: Прошепчите сообщение существу по вашему выбору в пределах дистанции, которое услышит только оно.

name: Poison Spray
description: Extend your hand toward a creature and project a puff of noxious gas.
descriptionRu: Протяните руку к существу и выпустите облако едкого газа.

name: Prestidigitation
description: Perform a minor magical trick - a spark, a smell, a small sensory flourish.
descriptionRu: Исполните мелкий волшебный трюк: искру, запах или другой небольшой эффект.

name: Produce Flame
description: A flickering flame appears in your hand, usable to light the way or thrown as an attack.
descriptionRu: Мерцающее пламя появляется в вашей руке - им можно осветить путь или метнуть как снаряд.

name: Resistance
description: Touch a willing creature and give it an extra d4 to add to one saving throw of its choice.
descriptionRu: Коснитесь согласного существа и дайте ему d4, который можно добавить к одному спасброску.

name: Sacred Flame
description: Flame-like radiance descends on a creature you can see, searing it with holy fire.
descriptionRu: Пламеподобное сияние нисходит на существо, которое вы видите, обжигая его святым огнём.

name: Shillelagh
description: Imbue a club or quarterstaff with nature's power, letting it strike with magical force.
descriptionRu: Наполните дубинку или посох силой природы, позволяя ей бить с волшебной силой.

name: Shocking Grasp
description: Lightning springs from your hand into a creature you're touching, and it can't take reactions until your next turn.
descriptionRu: Молния срывается с вашей руки в существо, которого вы касаетесь, и оно не может совершать реакции до начала вашего следующего хода.

name: Spare the Dying
description: Touch a living creature with 0 hit points to stabilize it.
descriptionRu: Коснитесь живого существа с 0 хитов, чтобы стабилизировать его.

name: Thaumaturgy
description: Manifest a minor wonder - a tremor, a flickering flame, a booming voice.
descriptionRu: Проявите малое чудо: дрожь земли, мерцание пламени, громовой голос.

name: Thorn Whip
description: A vine-like whip lashes out at a creature, dealing damage and pulling it closer.
descriptionRu: Похожий на лозу хлыст обрушивается на существо, нанося урон и притягивая его к вам.

name: True Strike
description: Focus your mind on one creature to gain insight into your next attack against it.
descriptionRu: Сосредоточьтесь на существе, чтобы получить преимущество на следующую атаку против него.

name: Vicious Mockery
description: Unleash an insult laced with subtle enchantments at a creature you can see.
descriptionRu: Обрушьте на существо, которое видите, оскорбление, наполненное тонкими чарами.

name: Burning Hands
description: A thin sheet of flame shoots forth from your outstretched fingertips.
descriptionRu: Тонкий лист пламени вырывается из ваших вытянутых пальцев.

name: Cure Wounds
description: A creature you touch regains a number of hit points.
descriptionRu: Существо, которого вы касаетесь, восстанавливает некоторое количество хитов.

name: Shield
description: An invisible barrier of magical force appears and protects you.
descriptionRu: Невидимый барьер магической силы появляется и защищает вас.

name: Scorching Ray
description: Create three rays of fire and hurl them at targets within range.

name: Web
description: Thick, sticky webs fill a 20-foot cube, restraining creatures caught in them.

name: Fireball
description: A bright streak flashes to a point you choose and blossoms with a low roar into an explosion of flame.

name: Ice Storm
description: A hail of rock-hard ice pounds to the ground in a cylindrical area.

name: Cone of Cold
description: A blast of cold air erupts from your hands in a 60-foot cone.

name: Chain Lightning
description: A bolt of lightning arcs toward a target, then leaps to other nearby targets.

name: Delayed Blast Fireball
description: A beam of yellow light streaks toward a point, exploding into a fireball that grows more destructive the longer it's left ticking.

name: Sunburst
description: Brilliant sunlight flashes in a 60-foot radius, blinding creatures and dealing heavy radiant damage.

name: Alarm
description: Sets an alarm against unwanted intrusion, alerting you audibly or mentally when a creature enters the warded area.
descriptionRu: Установите сигнализацию против нежеланного вторжения, которая оповестит вас звуком или мысленно, когда существо войдёт в охраняемую зону.

name: Animal Friendship
description: Convince a beast that you mean it no harm, calming it toward you for a day.
descriptionRu: Убедите зверя, что вы не желаете ему вреда, расположив его к себе на день.

name: Bane
description: Up to three creatures you choose must subtract a d4 from every attack roll and saving throw.
descriptionRu: До трёх существ по вашему выбору должны вычитать d4 из каждого броска атаки и спасброска.

name: Bless
description: Up to three creatures you choose add a d4 to every attack roll and saving throw.
descriptionRu: До трёх существ по вашему выбору прибавляют d4 к каждому броску атаки и спасброску.

name: Charm Person
description: One humanoid you can see must succeed a Wisdom save or regard you as a friendly acquaintance.
descriptionRu: Один гуманоид, которого вы видите, должен пройти испытание Мудрости, иначе будет считать вас дружелюбным знакомым.

name: Chromatic Orb
description: Hurl a sphere of energy whose damage type you choose on the spot.
descriptionRu: Метните сферу энергии, тип урона которой вы выбираете на месте.

name: Color Spray
description: A dazzling array of flashing, colored light blinds creatures in the area.
descriptionRu: Ослепительный сноп мерцающих цветных огней ослепляет существ в конусе.

name: Command
description: Speak a single word of command that a creature must obey.
descriptionRu: Произнесите одно слово команды, которому существо должно подчиниться.

name: Comprehend Languages
description: Understand the literal meaning of any language you hear or see written.
descriptionRu: Понимайте буквальный смысл любого языка, который слышите или видите написанным.

name: Compelled Duel
description: Bind a creature's attention to you, giving it disadvantage on attacking anyone but you.
descriptionRu: Привяжите внимание существа к себе, давая ему помеху на атаки против кого-либо, кроме вас.

name: Create or Destroy Water
description: Conjure up to 10 gallons of clean water, or destroy water in an open container.
descriptionRu: Призовите до 10 галлонов чистой воды или уничтожьте воду в открытом сосуде.

name: Detect Evil and Good
description: Sense the presence and location of celestials, fiends, undead, and consecrated ground within range.
descriptionRu: Почувствуйте присутствие и местоположение небожителей, исчадий, нежити и освящённой земли в пределах дистанции.

name: Detect Magic
description: Sense the presence of magic within 30 feet and see a faint aura around its source.
descriptionRu: Почувствуйте присутствие магии в пределах 30 футов и увидите слабое сияние вокруг её источника.

name: Detect Poison and Disease
description: Sense the presence and location of poisons, poisonous creatures, and diseases within range.
descriptionRu: Почувствуйте присутствие и местоположение ядов, ядовитых существ и болезней в пределах дистанции.

name: Disguise Self
description: Change your appearance, including clothing and gear, into another humanoid form.
descriptionRu: Измените свою внешность, включая одежду и снаряжение, приняв облик другого гуманоида.

name: Dissonant Whispers
description: Whisper a discordant melody only one creature can hear, wracking its mind with terrible pain.
descriptionRu: Прошепчите диссонирующую мелодию, которую услышит только одно существо, терзая его разум мучительной болью.

name: Divine Favor
description: Your weapon flares with holy energy, adding radiant damage to its next hits.
descriptionRu: Ваше оружие вспыхивает священной энергией, добавляя урон светом к следующим попаданиям.

name: Entangle
description: Grasping weeds and vines sprout from the ground, turning it into difficult terrain.
descriptionRu: Цепкие сорняки и лозы прорастают из земли, превращая её в труднопроходимую местность.

name: Ensnaring Strike
description: The next weapon hit you land causes thorny vines to restrain the target.
descriptionRu: Следующее попадание оружием вызывает колючие лозы, опутывающие цель.

name: Expeditious Retreat
description: Your speed increases, letting you Dash as a bonus action each turn.
descriptionRu: Ваша скорость увеличивается, позволяя совершать Рывок бонусным действием каждый ход.

name: Faerie Fire
description: Objects and creatures in the area are outlined in colored light, unable to benefit from being invisible.
descriptionRu: Предметы и существа в области очерчиваются цветным светом, теряя пользу от невидимости.

name: False Life
description: Bolster yourself with a necromantic simulacrum of health, gaining temporary hit points.
descriptionRu: Укрепите себя некромантическим подобием здоровья, получив временные хиты.

name: Feather Fall
description: Choose up to five falling creatures, slowing their descent to a gentle drift.
descriptionRu: Выберите до пяти падающих существ, замедлив их падение до плавного спуска.

name: Find Familiar
description: Summon a spirit that takes an animal form of your choosing to serve as a familiar.
descriptionRu: Призовите духа, принимающего облик животного по вашему выбору, чтобы служить вам фамильяром.

name: Find Steed
description: Summon a spirit that takes the form of a loyal, intelligent steed.
descriptionRu: Призовите духа, принимающего облик верного, разумного скакуна.

name: Fog Cloud
description: A sphere of fog fills the area, heavily obscuring it.
descriptionRu: Сфера тумана заполняет область, сильно скрывая её.

name: Goodberry
description: Up to ten berries grow, each a meal in miniature and each healing 1 hit point when eaten.
descriptionRu: До десяти ягод вырастают, каждая - миниатюрный обед, исцеляющий 1 хит при поедании.

name: Grease
description: Slick grease covers the ground, making it difficult terrain that can knock creatures prone.
descriptionRu: Скользкая смазка покрывает землю, делая её труднопроходимой и способной сбить существ с ног.

name: Guiding Bolt
description: A flash of light streaks toward a creature, and the next attack against it gains advantage.
descriptionRu: Вспышка света устремляется к существу, и следующая атака против него получает преимущество.

name: Hail of Thorns
description: Your next ranged weapon hit bursts into thorny vines, raining damage on nearby creatures.
descriptionRu: Ваше следующее попадание дальнобойным оружием разрывается колючими лозами, осыпая уроном соседние существа.

name: Healing Word
description: A creature of your choice regains hit points at range, no touch required.
descriptionRu: Существо по вашему выбору восстанавливает хиты на расстоянии, без необходимости касания.

name: Hellish Rebuke
description: You point at the creature that just hurt you, and the ground erupts in hellish flame around it.
descriptionRu: Вы указываете на существо, только что причинившее вам вред, и земля вокруг него охватывается адским пламенем.

name: Heroism
description: A willing creature is imbued with bravery, gaining temporary hit points and immunity to being frightened.
descriptionRu: Согласное существо наполняется отвагой, получая временные хиты и иммунитет к испугу.

name: Hex
description: Curse a creature so your attacks against it deal extra necrotic damage.
descriptionRu: Прокляните существо, чтобы ваши атаки против него наносили дополнительный урон некротической энергией.

name: Hunter's Mark
description: Mark a creature as your quarry, dealing extra damage to it whenever you hit.
descriptionRu: Отметьте существо как свою добычу, нанося ему дополнительный урон при каждом попадании.

name: Identify
description: Learn the properties, method of activation, and any curse on a magic item or ongoing effect.
descriptionRu: Узнайте свойства, способ активации и любое проклятие на магическом предмете или длящемся эффекте.

name: Illusory Script
description: Write a message that appears as gibberish unless read by someone you designate.
descriptionRu: Напишите сообщение, которое выглядит бессмыслицей для всех, кроме тех, кого вы укажете.

name: Inflict Wounds
description: Your touch channels negative energy that sears necrotic wounds into a creature.
descriptionRu: Ваше прикосновение направляет отрицательную энергию, выжигая некротические раны на существе.

name: Jump
description: A creature's jump distance triples for the duration.
descriptionRu: Дальность прыжка существа утраивается на время действия заклинания.

name: Longstrider
description: A creature's speed increases by 10 feet.
descriptionRu: Скорость существа увеличивается на 10 футов.

name: Mage Armor
description: A protective magical force surrounds an unarmored creature, setting its base AC.
descriptionRu: Защитная магическая сила окружает существо без доспеха, устанавливая его базовый КД.

name: Magic Missile
description: Three glowing darts of magical force strike unerringly, no attack roll needed.
descriptionRu: Три светящихся дротика магической силы поражают без промаха, бросок атаки не требуется.

name: Protection from Evil and Good
description: Ward a creature against aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead.
descriptionRu: Защитите существо от аберраций, небожителей, элементалей, фей, исчадий и нежити.

name: Purify Food and Drink
description: All non-magical food and drink in the area is purified and rendered free of poison and disease.
descriptionRu: Вся немагическая еда и питьё в области очищаются от яда и болезней.

name: Ray of Sickness
description: A ray of sickening greenish energy lashes out, poisoning the creature it strikes.
descriptionRu: Луч болезнетворной зеленоватой энергии поражает существо, отравляя его.

name: Sanctuary
description: Ward a creature so that any attacker must first succeed a Wisdom save to target it.
descriptionRu: Защитите существо так, чтобы любой нападающий сперва проходил испытание Мудрости, чтобы выбрать его целью.

name: Searing Smite
description: Your next weapon hit flares with fire, dealing extra damage and igniting the target.
descriptionRu: Ваше следующее попадание оружием вспыхивает огнём, нанося дополнительный урон и поджигая цель.

name: Shield of Faith
description: A shimmering field surrounds a creature, granting it a bonus to AC.
descriptionRu: Мерцающее поле окружает существо, даруя ему бонус к КД.

name: Silent Image
description: Create a purely visual illusion of an object, creature, or effect.
descriptionRu: Создайте чисто зрительную иллюзию предмета, существа или эффекта.

name: Sleep
description: Creatures in the area fall into a magical slumber, weakest affected first.
descriptionRu: Существа в области погружаются в волшебную дрёму, слабейшие первыми.

name: Speak with Animals
description: Gain the ability to understand and verbally communicate with beasts.
descriptionRu: Получите способность понимать и вербально общаться со зверями.

name: Tasha's Hideous Laughter
description: A creature is overcome with mirth, falling prone and helpless with laughter.
descriptionRu: Существо охватывает неудержимое веселье, и оно падает ничком, беспомощное от смеха.

name: Tenser's Floating Disk
description: Create a horizontal disk of force that floats after you, carrying cargo.
descriptionRu: Создайте горизонтальный диск силы, парящий за вами и способный нести груз.

name: Thunderous Smite
description: Your next weapon hit rings out with thunder, dealing extra damage and knocking the target back.
descriptionRu: Ваше следующее попадание оружием раздаётся громом, нанося дополнительный урон и отбрасывая цель.

name: Thunderwave
description: A wave of thunderous force sweeps out from you, pushing creatures away.
descriptionRu: Волна громовой силы прокатывается от вас, отталкивая существ.

name: Unseen Servant
description: Create an invisible, mindless force that can perform simple labor at your command.
descriptionRu: Создайте невидимую, бездумную силу, способную выполнять простую работу по вашей команде.

name: Witch Bolt
description: A beam of crackling energy lances out and arcs back to you each turn, dealing damage anew.
descriptionRu: Луч потрескивающей энергии бьёт в цель и каждый ход возвращается к вам, вновь нанося урон.

name: Wrathful Smite
description: Your next weapon hit is charged with psychic wrath, dealing extra damage and frightening the target.
descriptionRu: Ваше следующее попадание оружием заряжено психической яростью, нанося дополнительный урон и пугая цель.

name: Acid Arrow
description: A shimmering green arrow streaks to its target, bursting into acid that also splashes a moment later.

name: Aid
description: Bolster up to three creatures' fortitude, increasing their maximum and current hit points.

name: Alter Self
description: Reshape your own body - grow gills, sprout claws, or take on another's appearance.

name: Animal Messenger
description: A tiny beast carries a short message to a location or creature you describe.

name: Arcane Lock
description: Ward a door, chest, or portal so only you and those you name may open it.

name: Augury
description: Ask the powers of fate to render a simple omen - weal, woe, or something in between - about a course of action.

name: Barkskin
description: A creature's skin toughens like bark, setting a minimum Armor Class.

name: Beast Sense
description: Perceive the world through the senses of a beast you touch.

name: Blindness/Deafness
description: Rob a creature of sight or hearing unless it resists.

name: Blur
description: Your outline blurs, shifting and wavering, making you harder to hit.

name: Branding Smite
description: Your next weapon hit brands the target with searing light visible through any obstruction.

name: Calm Emotions
description: Suppress violent emotion in a group, quieting a fight or a mob.

name: Cloud of Daggers
description: Fill a cube of air with spinning daggers that slash anything passing through.

name: Continual Flame
description: A flame springs into being on an object, giving off heatless light forever.

name: Cordon of Arrows
description: Plant four ordinary arrows in the ground that fire themselves at intruders.

name: Crown of Madness
description: A crown of jagged iron takes shape on a humanoid's head, compelling it to attack whoever you choose.

name: Darkness
description: Magical darkness spreads from a point you choose, snuffing out most other light.

name: Darkvision
description: A creature gains the ability to see in the dark as if it were dim light.

name: Detect Thoughts
description: Read the surface thoughts of one creature you can see within 30 feet.

name: Enhance Ability
description: Touch a creature and bolster one of its abilities, granting advantage on checks that use it.

name: Enlarge/Reduce
description: A creature or object grows to twice its size, or shrinks to half.

name: Enthrall
description: Weave a captivating performance that distracts everyone nearby, dropping their guard against you.

name: Find Traps
description: Sense the presence of any trap within range.

name: Flame Blade
description: Summon a fiery blade of scorching flame in your hand.

name: Flaming Sphere
description: A 5-foot ball of fire rolls at your command, scorching anything it touches.

name: Gentle Repose
description: Protect a corpse from decay and from becoming undead.

name: Gust of Wind
description: A powerful wind blasts out from you, pushing creatures and extinguishing flames.

name: Heat Metal
description: A metal object glows red-hot, searing anyone in contact with it.

name: Hold Person
description: A humanoid target is paralyzed, frozen in place unless it resists.

name: Invisibility
description: A creature you touch becomes invisible until it attacks or casts a spell.

name: Knock
description: A loud knock sounds and a lock, bar, or arcane ward on an object opens.

name: Lesser Restoration
description: Touch a creature and end one disease or condition afflicting it.

name: Levitate
description: A creature or object rises into the air and hovers, floating wherever you direct.

name: Locate Animals or Plants
description: Learn the direction and distance to the nearest creature or plant of a specific kind.

name: Locate Object
description: Sense the direction to a well-known or specific object within 1,000 feet.

name: Magic Mouth
description: Implant a message in an object that it speaks aloud when a trigger you set occurs.

name: Magic Weapon
description: A nonmagical weapon becomes magical, granting a bonus to attack and damage rolls.

name: Mirror Image
description: Three illusory duplicates of yourself spring into being, confusing attackers about which is real.

name: Misty Step
description: Surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

name: Moonbeam
description: A silvery beam of pale light shines down in a cylinder, searing creatures within.

name: Pass without Trace
description: A veil of shadow and silence radiates from you, masking you and your companions from detection.

name: Phantasmal Force
description: Craft an illusion that plays directly on a target's mind, seeming completely real to it alone.

name: Prayer of Healing
description: Up to six creatures regain hit points after a period of respite and prayer.

name: Protection from Poison
description: Neutralize one poison afflicting a creature and grant it resistance against further poison.

name: Ray of Enfeeblement
description: A black beam of enervating energy weakens a creature's physical might.

name: Rope Trick
description: A rope rises and disappears into an extradimensional space at its top, accessible only by climbing it.

name: See Invisibility
description: See invisible creatures and objects as if they were visible, and see into the Ethereal Plane.

name: Shatter
description: A sudden loud, ringing noise painfully assaults creatures in the area and can crack fragile objects.

name: Silence
description: For the duration, no sound can be created within or pass through a sphere centered on a point you choose.

name: Spider Climb
description: A creature gains the ability to move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and ceilings while leaving its hands free.

name: Spike Growth
description: The ground twists with hidden spikes, turning the area into difficult, wounding terrain.

name: Spiritual Weapon
description: A spectral weapon of your deity's favored form springs into being, striking on your command.

name: Suggestion
description: Suggest a reasonable-sounding course of action to a creature, compelling it to follow through.

name: Warding Bond
description: Link your fate to another's, sharing your protection and any harm that befalls them.

name: Zone of Truth
description: Creatures within a 15-foot-radius zone cannot speak a deliberate lie while inside it.

name: Animate Dead
description: Raise a corpse or bones as an undead servant obedient to your will.

name: Aura of Vitality
description: A healing aura surrounds you, letting you channel vitality into wounded allies as a bonus action.

name: Beacon of Hope
description: Bolster the resolve of those around you, granting advantage on saves against despair and on death saves.

name: Bestow Curse
description: Touch a creature and lay a curse on it, hindering its every effort.

name: Blinding Smite
description: Your next weapon hit flares with radiance, dealing extra damage and blinding the target.

name: Call Lightning
description: Summon a storm cloud that lets you call down bolts of lightning at will.

name: Clairvoyance
description: Create an invisible sensor at a distant location, letting you see or hear through it.

name: Conjure Animals
description: Summon a fey spirit that takes the form of beasts to fight at your side.

name: Conjure Barrage
description: Hurl a spectral duplicate of a weapon that explodes outward, striking everything in a cone.

name: Counterspell
description: Interrupt a creature in the process of casting a spell, unraveling it before it takes effect.

name: Create Food and Water
description: Conjure a feast of simple food and clean water, enough to sustain a small group.

name: Crusader's Mantle
description: A field of radiant power surrounds you, adding holy force to the weapon strikes of nearby allies.

name: Daylight
description: A 60-foot radius of true sunlight springs from a point you choose, banishing darkness.

name: Dispel Magic
description: Choose a creature, object, or effect within range and end the magical effects on it.

name: Elemental Weapon
description: A weapon is imbued with one of the elements, gaining a bonus and extra elemental damage on hit.

name: Fear
description: Project a phantasmal image of your most terrible aspect, sending creatures in a cone fleeing in terror.

name: Feign Death
description: A willing creature falls into a deathlike trance, appearing dead to all inspection.

name: Fly
description: A creature you touch gains a flying speed for the duration.

name: Gaseous Form
description: A willing creature transforms into a misty cloud, able to seep through cracks and float on the air.

name: Glyph of Warding
description: Inscribe a glyph that unleashes a stored spell or explosion when its trigger condition is met.

name: Haste
description: A willing creature's speed doubles and its reactions sharpen for the duration.

name: Hunger of Hadar
description: A rift to a starless void opens, filling an area with grasping cold and gnawing hunger.

name: Hypnotic Pattern
description: A twisting pattern of colors weaves through the air, leaving those who see it dazed and captivated.

name: Leomund's Tiny Hut
description: A shimmering dome of force springs up around you, sheltering you and your companions from the world.

name: Lightning Arrow
description: Your next ranged weapon hit crackles with lightning, striking the target and arcing to those nearby.

name: Lightning Bolt
description: A stroke of lightning blasts out from you in a line, striking everything in its path.

name: Magic Circle
description: Draw a 10-foot cylinder of protection that wards against a chosen kind of extraplanar creature.

name: Major Image
description: A convincing illusion of an object, creature, or effect, complete with sound and smell.

name: Mass Healing Word
description: Speak a word of restoration and up to six creatures within range regain hit points.

name: Meld into Stone
description: Step into a stone surface and merge your body with it, hiding within the rock itself.

name: Nondetection
description: Hide a creature, object, or place from divination magic and scrying for the duration.

name: Phantom Steed
description: A quasi-real, horselike creature takes shape to carry a rider swiftly over long distances.

name: Plant Growth
description: Overgrow an area with lush vegetation, or enrich the land so its plants flourish for a season.

name: Protection from Energy
description: A creature gains resistance to one damage type of your choosing for the duration.

name: Remove Curse
description: End all curses afflicting a creature, or break the binding holding a creature planebound.

name: Revivify
description: Return a creature slain within the last minute to life, so long as its body remains whole.

name: Sending
description: Send a short telepathic message to a creature you know anywhere, with a reply if it chooses.

name: Sleet Storm
description: Freezing rain and sleet fall in the area, coating the ground in slick ice and obscuring vision.

name: Speak with Dead
description: A corpse's spirit is compelled to answer up to five questions truthfully, as best it can.

name: Speak with Plants
description: Plants in the area gain limited sentience and mobility, able to converse and act on your request.

name: Spirit Guardians
description: Spectral guardians flock around you, wounding hostile creatures who come near.

name: Stinking Cloud
description: A nauseating gas billows out, causing creatures inside to retch and gag.

name: Tongues
description: A creature you touch understands and can speak any language for the duration.

name: Vampiric Touch
description: Your touch withers life and channels the stolen vitality into your own wounds.

name: Water Breathing
description: Up to ten willing creatures gain the ability to breathe underwater for the duration.

name: Water Walk
description: Up to ten willing creatures gain the ability to move across any liquid surface as if it were solid ground.

name: Wind Wall
description: A wall of strong wind rises, deflecting arrows, gasses, and small creatures away from it.

name: Arcane Eye
description: Create an invisible, magical eye that flies wherever you direct it and relays what it sees.

name: Aura of Life
description: A 30-foot aura of positive energy grants resistance to necrotic damage and revives dying allies.

name: Aura of Purity
description: A 30-foot aura wards allies against disease and grants resistance to poison and worsening conditions.

name: Banishment
description: A creature you can see is banished to a harmless demiplane, or sent home if it's not native here.

name: Blight
description: Necromantic energy sears the moisture and life from a creature or withers a plant outright.

name: Compulsion
description: Creatures affected must move away from you in a direction you choose.

name: Confusion
description: Creatures in the area lose their footing on reality itself, acting randomly and erratically.

name: Conjure Minor Elementals
description: Summon lesser elemental spirits to fight at your command.

name: Conjure Woodland Beings
description: Summon fey creatures of the forest to your side.

name: Control Water
description: Command a great mass of water, parting, redirecting, or raising it as you will.

name: Death Ward
description: A creature warded by this spell survives falling to 0 hit points once, retaining 1 hit point instead.

name: Destructive Wave
description: Slam the ground, sending a wave of thunderous, radiant force out from you in all directions.

name: Dimension Door
description: Teleport yourself and up to one willing creature to any spot you can visualize within range.

name: Divination
description: Contact a deity or a divine proxy to ask a single question about events up to a week hence.

name: Dominate Beast
description: Seize control of a beast's mind, issuing it telepathic commands it must obey.

name: Evard's Black Tentacles
description: Rubbery black tentacles erupt from the ground across the area, grasping and crushing anything they catch.

name: Fabricate
description: Convert raw materials into a finished product of the same material, shaped however you like.

name: Fire Shield
description: Wreathe yourself in flickering flame or shimmering cold, resisting the opposite damage and searing attackers.

name: Freedom of Movement
description: A creature you touch moves and acts unhindered by magical restraint, difficult terrain, or paralysis.

name: Giant Insect
description: Arthropods you can see swell to Large size or larger, obeying your commands in battle.

name: Grasping Vine
description: A vine sprouts and snakes toward a creature you choose, grabbing and pulling it toward you.

name: Guardian of Faith
description: A Large spectral guardian appears and hovers over the area, attacking any hostile creature that draws near.

name: Hallucinatory Terrain
description: Make a large natural area look, sound, and smell like some other sort of terrain entirely.

name: Locate Creature
description: Sense the direction to a specific creature or kind of creature you're familiar with, up to 1,000 feet away.

name: Mordenkainen's Faithful Hound
description: Summon a phantom watchdog that barks at intruders and can bite anything it doesn't recognize.

name: Otiluke's Resilient Sphere
description: A sphere of shimmering force encloses a creature or object, sealing it away from the world.

name: Phantasmal Killer
description: Conjure an illusory manifestation of a creature's deepest fear, visible only to it, tormenting it relentlessly.

name: Polymorph
description: A creature you can see is transformed into a new form, its statistics replaced by the new shape's.

name: Staggering Smite
description: Your next weapon hit pierces a creature's mind with psychic force, staggering it and stealing its focus.

name: Stone Shape
description: Reshape a section of stone into any form that suits your purpose, within reason.

name: Stoneskin
description: A creature's flesh hardens like stone, resisting nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

name: Wall of Fire
description: A wall of roaring fire springs up, scorching anything that touches it or stands too close.

name: Animate Objects
description: Up to ten nonmagical objects spring to life, animated to fight and move at your command.

name: Antilife Shell
description: A shimmering barrier surrounds you, keeping living creatures from passing through or attacking within.

name: Awaken
description: Bestow the spark of true sentience on a beast or plant, granting it intelligence and loyalty.

name: Banishing Smite
description: Your next weapon hit surrounds the target with force, and enough damage sends it to another plane entirely.

name: Circle of Power
description: A 30-foot aura shields your allies from magic, granting advantage on saves against spells.

name: Cloudkill
description: A billowing, poisonous cloud spreads out from a point you choose, moving with the wind and choking anything inside.

name: Commune
description: Ask your deity three yes-or-no questions and receive an answer, if one can be given.

name: Commune with Nature
description: Become one with the land, gaining knowledge of the terrain and creatures for miles around.

name: Conjure Elemental
description: Summon a greater elemental spirit to fight at your command for the duration.

name: Contact Other Plane
description: Send your mind out to a knowing entity beyond the mortal plane, risking your sanity for answers.

name: Contagion
description: Touch a creature and afflict it with a virulent, magical disease that worsens over days.

name: Creation
description: Shape shadowstuff and raw magic into a nonliving object, real enough for the duration to matter.

name: Dispel Evil and Good
description: Call on celestial or fiendish power to protect you and repel or banish otherworldly creatures.

name: Dominate Person
description: Seize control of a humanoid's mind, issuing it telepathic commands it must obey.

name: Dream
description: Shape a creature's dreams, sending it a message or a nightmare from anywhere on the same plane.

name: Flame Strike
description: A column of divine fire roars down from above, searing everything caught within it.

name: Geas
description: Lay a magical command on a creature, punishing it with pain each time it strays from your order.

name: Greater Restoration
description: Undo one of the more debilitating effects afflicting a creature - a curse, exhaustion, even lost ability score.

name: Hallow
description: Consecrate a site so divine and fell creatures alike find it impossible to enter.

name: Hold Monster
description: A creature is paralyzed, frozen in place unless it can shake off the magic gripping its mind.

name: Insect Plague
description: A roiling cloud of biting, stinging locusts fills the area, tearing at anything caught inside.

name: Legend Lore
description: Speak the name of a person, place, or object and learn what significant lore you know of it.

name: Mass Cure Wounds
description: A wave of healing energy washes over a group of creatures, restoring hit points to each.

name: Mislead
description: You turn invisible while a perfect illusory double of yourself appears and acts as you direct.

name: Modify Memory
description: Reach into a creature's mind and reshape a portion of its memories to your liking.

name: Passwall
description: Create a passage through wood, plaster, or stone, open for as long as you maintain the spell.

name: Planar Binding
description: Bind a celestial, elemental, fey, or fiend into your service for the duration.

name: Raise Dead
description: Return a creature dead no longer than ten days to life, mending its body and calling its soul back.

name: Rary's Telepathic Bond
description: Forge a telepathic link between willing creatures, letting them communicate mind to mind regardless of language.

name: Reincarnate
description: A dead humanoid's soul is called back and given an entirely new body, of a race not necessarily its own.

name: Scrying
description: See and hear a particular creature anywhere on the same plane, so long as you resist its will.

name: Seeming
description: Every creature you choose takes on a new illusory appearance, disguised down to the voice.

name: Swift Quiver
description: Your quiver refills itself with unerring, self-replenishing ammunition, letting you attack twice as fast.

name: Telekinesis
description: Move a creature or object with the power of your mind alone, lifting, dragging, or hurling it about.

name: Teleportation Circle
description: Draw a circle that opens a temporary portal to a permanent teleportation circle you know elsewhere.

name: Tree Stride
description: Step into a tree and pass instantly through the earth to emerge from another tree of the same kind.

name: Wall of Force
description: An invisible wall of pure magical force springs into existence, impassable by anything physical or ethereal.

name: Wall of Stone
description: Nonmagical stone rises from the ground or air, forming a solid wall you can shape as you like.

name: Arcane Gate
description: Two linked circular portals open, letting anything step from one straight through to the other.

name: Blade Barrier
description: A vertical, twisting wall of whirling blades erupts from the ground, shredding anything that tries to pass.

name: Circle of Death
description: A sphere of negative energy bursts outward, draining the life from every creature it touches.

name: Conjure Fey
description: Summon a fey creature or beast tied to the fey to fight at your command.

name: Contingency
description: Store a spell within yourself, primed to trigger the instant a condition you set comes to pass.

name: Create Undead
description: Raise up to three corpses as ghouls, bound to obey your commands until they're destroyed.

name: Disintegrate
description: A thin, green ray lances out and, if it connects hard enough, reduces its target to fine dust.

name: Drawmij's Instant Summons
description: Enchant an item so that, once prepared, a single word teleports it straight into your hand.

name: Eyebite
description: Your eyes turn black, and a creature you look at is stricken with sleep, fear, or sickness.

name: Find the Path
description: Discern the shortest, most direct route to a location you name, however far away it may be.

name: Flesh to Stone
description: A creature you can see begins to petrify, its flesh slowly hardening to unmoving stone.

name: Forbiddance
description: Ward a great tract of land against planar travel and certain kinds of creatures crossing in.

name: Globe of Invulnerability
description: An immobile, faintly shimmering barrier surrounds you, blocking spells of 5th level and lower.

name: Guards and Wards
description: A whole area is laced with a web of minor magical effects, hindering intruders at every turn.

name: Harm
description: A violent, virulent affliction of negative energy tears into a creature's body and mind.

name: Heal
description: A great surge of positive energy washes through a creature, closing wounds and lifting a blindness or disease.

name: Heroes' Feast
description: A sumptuous feast appears, and everyone who partakes gains resolve, health, and protection for a day.

name: Mass Suggestion
description: Suggest a reasonable-sounding course of action to up to twelve creatures at once, compelling each to follow through.

name: Move Earth
description: Excavate, reshape, and relocate great sections of dirt and stone over the course of the spell.

name: Otiluke's Freezing Sphere
description: A frigid globe of ice streaks to a point and bursts, blasting the area with freezing shards.

name: Otto's Irresistible Dance
description: A creature is compelled to burst into an erratic dance, unable to focus on anything else.

name: Planar Ally
description: Call out to an otherworldly entity for aid, offering payment for a service in return.

name: Programmed Illusion
description: An illusion springs to life and performs a scripted routine each time its trigger condition is met.

name: Sunbeam
description: A beam of brilliant sunlight flashes out, searing and blinding everything it touches.

name: Transport via Plants
description: Step into one healthy, Large plant and emerge from another of the same kind, anywhere it may be rooted.

name: True Seeing
description: A creature you touch sees truly - through illusions, invisibility, disguise, and the veil into the Ethereal Plane.

name: Wall of Ice
description: A wall of solid ice rises from the ground, cold enough to numb anything that touches it.

name: Wind Walk
description: You and your companions turn to gaseous, wind-borne mist, flying swiftly and far across the land.

name: Word of Recall
description: Speak a word of teleportation and you and your companions are drawn instantly to a sanctuary you've bound the spell to.
